title: Privileged access observability: Incident learnings, SLOs and remediation plan for auth & audit
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary:
On 2026-02-20 a rollout of parts of RBAC v2 and a schema change in the audit pipeline coincided with a SAML IdP certificate rotation test. The net effect: a ~3 hour window during which a subset of admin role changes were not recorded in the audit index and several SSO sign-ins returned intermittent errors. The incident surfaced through elevated PagerDuty alerts for failed impersonation attempts and customer reports of missing audit entries.

Root causes (consolidated):
- Role-assignment race: an optimization in the RBAC v2 role assignment path allowed a transient state where role bindings were created without emitting the structured audit event. (Bug in assignment worker, race with cache eviction.)
- Audit pipeline schema mismatch: a non-backward-compatible field rename in the audit event schema caused the ingestion pipeline to silently drop ~12% of incoming auth events for 4 hours before alerts triggered.
- Alert gaps: the existing alerting focused on raw ingestion failures and Logstash errors but did not have a high-fidelity "audit event completeness" SLO with short-window burn-down alerts.
- Test coverage: CI lacked an end-to-end synthetic SSO+RBAC flow that would have caught the combination of issues during staging.

Observed impact and metrics (approx):
- Duration: ~2026-02-20 02:12 UTC to 2026-02-20 05:25 UTC (partial recovery earlier, full re-ingest later)
- Missed SLOs: audit-log-delivery (target 99.95% within 5m) — observed 98.6% during window; auth-success-rate (target 99.99%) — brief drop to 99.86% for SAML flows.
- Customers: 3 enterprise tenants flagged missing privileged-change logs; internal product owners reported inability to reconcile admin actions for 2 support tickets.

Proposed SLOs (new/adjusted):
- audit.event.delivery.p95_window_5m >= 99.95% (alert when <99.9% for 5m; page on PD after 15m).
- auth.sso.success_rate.1h >= 99.99% (alert for drop >0.1% sustained 10m).
- admin.privileged_change.completeness.24h >= 99.999% (daily report, page if daily completeness <99.99%).
- privileged_change.unexpected_rate (anomaly) — baseline weekly avg; page on >5x deviation in 10m.

Alerting & Runbook changes (short term):
- Create an "audit-completeness" metric derived from pairing emitted audit events against the canonical role-change store (job: compare writes to audit index every 5m). Alert if mismatch >0.05% for 10m.
- Add a flamechart-based alert for schema mismatch errors in the ingestion path (increment if event transform errors > 10/min).
- Update SSO health check to include a synthetic login that performs: SAML auth -> create ephemeral role binding -> verify audit event appears in index within 60s. Run every 5m from three regions.
- PagerDuty: route auth/audit pages to Security-Auth rotation policy; add escalation to Platform Reliability after 30m.

Remediations completed (deployed):
- Hotfix: role-assignment worker guarded against emitting events before write-confirmation (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3284). Deployed 2026-02-20 04:05 UTC.
- Re-ingestion: backfill job reprocessed dropped events and repaired indexes (run id: backfill-20260220-1, dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/alerts/audit-backfill).
- Short-term rollback: the schema change was rolled back to the backwards-compatible format while pipeline transforms were updated.

Planned technical actions (next 30 days):
- Instrumentation: add end-to-end "event lineage id" to role-change flows so missing events can be correlated between services and audit index. (Owner: @liam)
- Pipeline: adopt strict-schema CI for audit transforms that fails PRs when a non-additive change is detected. (Owner: @maya)
